highlights: Developing an in-house Knowledge-Based Authentication component using React that secures Genesys Cloud calls while exposing zero PII to agents.
Developing a data aggregator and an engine in .NET Core that produces randomized questions from 20+ internal data sources while supporting 250+ insurance carriers.

Developed a reusable web component to dynamically load compliance templates and process user consent. With a dedicated database architecture, it stores consent states in a single domain for 10+ micro-frontends.
Developed 2 major modules from scratch for the KoinXBooks - Accounting platform using Next.js.
Migrated the Transactions page from Redux Toolkit to React Query and caching transactions for 500+ wallets client-side, effectively reducing API calls and database reads by over 30%.
Replaced ad-hoc plugin internals with a typed OOP core, cutting release time by 70%, and resulted in 50% decrease in monthly bug report volume.
Rewrote the plugin core algorithm utilising dynamic tree caching to increase conversion throughput by 500% and also enable the plugin to process multiple design frames concurrently.
Added React support to the code output to grow monthly users by 3x (from 5,000 to 20,000+), and added Mixpanel triggers project-wide to capture 200,000+ events monthly.
